caption: A driving synthwave track powered by a punchy, gated-reverb drum machine and a relentless sequenced synth bassline. Bright, arpeggiated synthesizers create a shimmering, retro-futuristic texture. A clear, melodic female vocal, sung in French and treated with spacious reverb, soars over the electronic arrangement. The track features dynamic shifts, including an atmospheric bridge with whispered vocals and a brief, melodic synth-guitar lead. The song concludes with a spoken-word outro over fading ambient pads, cementing its mysterious, cyberpunk aesthetic.
lyrics:
[Intro - Synth Arpeggio & Drum Machine]

[Verse 1]
Lichter flackern, ein endloser Traum
Mitarathon in der Zeit, ein verlorener Raum
Melodien fließen, Träume erwachen
Gefangen im Staub, ein Blick in die Nacht

[Pre-Chorus]
[Synth lead melody]

[Synth lead melody]
Ein Blick in die Nacht

[Chorus]

Die Reise beginnt, komm folg mir drauf
